title: Field Marshal Munir Reviews Security and Operational Readiness in Turbat
detail: Field Marshal Asim Munir, Chief of Defence Forces, visited Turbat in Balochistan on Nov 19, 2026, where he was briefed on the security situation, operational readiness and socio-economic development initiatives. He met troops engaged in operations against what the military calls externally sponsored terrorism and reaffirmed army support for peace and development in the province, as Islamabad courts investment in the resource-rich region despite continuing militant attacks.
